data.body_html:
Starlite Festival 2026 is set to light up Marbella's Auditorio Cantera de Nagüeles from July to August, drawing international headliners and thousands of music fans to the Costa del Sol. For those who want to elevate the experience beyond a standard concert night, pairing a Marbella yacht charter with Starlite tickets creates an unforgettable day-to-evening itinerary. Depart from Puerto Banús, cruise the Mediterranean, and arrive at the festival relaxed and ready.

Why Combine a Yacht Charter with Starlite Festival 2026?

A typical Starlite evening involves traffic, parking, and queuing. By chartering a private boat, you swap stress for sea breeze. Spend the afternoon swimming at Cala del Faro or Cabopino, enjoy an open bar with cava and beer, then step ashore at Puerto Banús just 10 minutes from the venue. It's a seamless transition from ocean luxury to world-class music.

Our Fleet for Starlite Festival Charters

We maintain a diverse fleet of 16 boats moored in Puerto Banús. For Starlite evenings, the most popular choices balance comfort, speed, and capacity.

  • Tier A – Astondoa 40 & Azimut 39: €749/2h or €2,299/8h. Both 12.5m, carry 9–11 passengers, and include skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT. Ideal for couples or small groups.
  • Tier B – Mangusta 80 (white or grey): €4,719 minimum 4h. 24m length, 12 passengers, plus a free jet ski. Perfect for larger parties wanting a statement boat.
  • Other boats: Pricing on request via WhatsApp. Options include the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax), and Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax).

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, and Spanish IVA (21%). No extras, no surprises.

How to Book Starlite Festival 2026 Tickets Alongside Your Charter

We do not sell festival tickets directly, but our concierge team can guide you to official vendors and recommend the best ticket tiers for your group. VIP tickets grant access to premium viewing areas and bars, while general admission offers a lively atmosphere. For the smoothest experience, book your charter first, then purchase tickets for a concert on the same day. Contact us via WhatsApp for personalised advice.

Sample Itinerary: Sunset Cruise + Starlite Night

16:00 – Board your yacht at Puerto Banús. Welcome drink and safety briefing.
16:30 – Cruise east towards Cabopino or west to Cala Cortés. Anchor for a swim.
18:30 – Sunset drinks on deck with cava and snacks.
19:45 – Return to Puerto Banús. Disembark.
20:15 – Taxi to Auditorio Cantera de Nagüeles (€15–€20, 10 min).
21:00 – Concert begins. Enjoy the show.

This 4-hour charter (€1,498 on Tier A boats) gives you ample time without rushing. For a longer day, the 8-hour option (€2,299) allows a second swim stop and lunch at a chiringuito.

Best Boats for Groups and Special Occasions

If you're celebrating a birthday or anniversary, the Maiora 26m (12 pax) offers a spacious saloon and sunpad area. For a sporty ride, the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) hits 38 knots. Families often choose the Lagoon 380 catamaran (11.6m, 10 pax) for stability and shade. All depart from Puerto Banús – see our full fleet on the Marbella yacht charter homepage.

What to Expect at Starlite Festival 2026

Starlite takes place in a natural quarry amphitheatre with capacity for 4,000. The 2026 line-up will be announced in early 2026, but past seasons have featured artists like Sting, Tom Jones, and Enrique Iglesias. The venue has multiple bars, food stalls, and a VIP lounge. August temperatures in Marbella average 30°C during the day, dropping to 22°C at night – bring a light jacket.
